svg.title: Filter, group and sort by a team’s own fields — SoftTrack web design mockup (#327)
svg.desc: The team’s own fields join the board’s filters under the team’s name, with a question for every kind of field, including empty. They are applied in the query, kept by saved views and carried by links. A select or user field can group the board, where dragging a card sets the value, and a number or date field can sort the list.
svg.text: Filter, group and sort by a team’s own fields
A field is a filter like any other

svg.text: Sort by a number or a date
Done when every kind of field filters the board, list and CSV export in the query through _build_ticket_filters, on Postgres with jsonb and on SQLite with JSON functions; when “me”
is resolved per request; when saved views keep field filters and lose a deleted field’s; when a select or user field groups the board and dragging sets it; and when a number or date
field sorts the list with empty values last.

Chips, as for every other filter.
A link carries them and a
board, the count and the CSV export agree.
Dragging a card to another column sets the value, as grouping by epic does. “None” is a column too.
Each kind asks the question its values allow. Empty is a question every kind can ask.
An archived field keeps filtering. A deleted one leaves the view, widened, as a deleted status does.
A ticket with no value comes last whichever way round, as an unsized ticket does for estimates.
Label, epic, sprint, type and due, as today
